page.overview:
Who is Yamato?

A rival ninja of the Bushinryu dressed in Kabuki gear and fighting with a naginata. He's the rival of Ginzu and has associated himself with Scumocide to become a Super Criminal. He fights using his naginata to strike or by summoning other ninjas to assist him.
